data.completion_memo: Created the strict TypeScript React/Vite/pnpm desktop package and Tauri 2 shell. It supplies provider-neutral component, graph, collection and native-presentation adapters, renders a placeholder window, and builds successfully with both Vite and the native Tauri build.
data.description: Create the bundled Tauri desktop shell and strict-TypeScript React/Vite/pnpm presentation package. Establish Aworkit-owned adapter seams for the component, graph, collection, and native-presentation dependencies without implementing feature screens. The result must build and open a local placeholder desktop window.
data.title: M01.2 — Scaffold the Tauri and React desktop presentation
